headline: Linea House / Instinto Estudio
context: In the heart of the Guiones jungle in Nosara , Instinto Estudio designed two tropical houses that use architecture as a series of lines to frame the landscape, encourage natural ventilation, and create spaces to gather in close contact with nature.
